title: Microcopy
summary: Microcopy is text attached to a control or decision; it should reduce uncertainty at the point of action.

MUST.text: Place helper text adjacent to the control; distinguish label, hint and placeholder.
Link to CMP-002 for input, label and placeholder ownership; do not redefine those rules here.

SHOULD.text: State constraints, format and consequences before the user commits.
Keep helper text under ~12 words; move detail into help or docs.

AVOID.text: Do not use a placeholder as the only label or instruction.
Do not restate the label verbatim in the hint; add new information.

DECIDE.decision: Label names the field; hint adds rule or example
Show before entry, not only after failure
Mark "(optional)" rather than relying on asterisk convention
Link to docs; keep control text short

EXAMPLE.good: Label "Work email"; hint "Use your company address, not a personal one."

FAILURE_MODES: Placeholder-only labels disappear once the user starts typing.
Hints that restate labels waste space and add no value.
Constraints discovered only after a failed submit.
Long helper text wraps and obscures the input.
